args.subtitle: A cozy escape in a narrow alley.
args.title: Sauna of Knits
why: The shelf walls embrace you, showcasing the delicate textures of the knitwear against a grounding clay backdrop.
The central steaming stone hearth acts as your anchor, grounding you in the heart of the sanctuary.
The intentional path forces a slower pace, encouraging you to immerse yourself in the tactile journey.
The warm wood grain counter provides a final, grounded interaction before you return to the winter cold.
args.quote: Where the ritual of warmth meets the softness of knitwear.
args.line: Step into a sanctuary where the biting cold of the winter forest dissolves into the gentle warmth of a steaming sauna.
args.synopsis: You enter the narrow boutique and are immediately enveloped by the humid, wood-scented air. Your journey begins at the central steaming stone hearth, where the mist clears to reveal the intricate knitwear displayed on the surrounding shelves. You circle the hearth, feeling the shift in atmosphere before being guided along the rich, textured clay walls. Finally, you reach the back, where the warm wood grain counter offers a moment of quiet transaction.

stops.sub: A final moment of reflection before leaving the warmth.
